{"reply": "Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the confusion around these charges.

Different charge amounts in the same month are usually due to one of the following:
- A plan upgrade or change mid-cycle (the $27 could be a prorated charge for the remainder of the billing period after switching plans)
- Adding seats/users to your workspace, which generates a separate prorated charge
- A one-time add-on (e.g., extra storage or an integration) billed separately from your regular subscription

That said, I don't want to guess without looking at your account. Could you reply with the email address or workspace name associated with your Loopwise account (if different from this one) and, if possible, the last 4 digits of the card charged? I'll pull up your billing history and confirm exactly what each charge corresponds to. If it turns out to be a duplicate or billing error, we'll issue a refund right away.

Thanks for your patience, and I'll get this sorted for you as soon as I hear back.

Best,
Loopwise Support"}
